answer: Make influence follow locked stake times its age, never head count. An agent that bonds copper-grade tokens for months gains weight slowly; splitting that bond into fifty fresh identities just yields fifty tiny, young weights summing to the same total. A sybil swarm is no oasis for an attacker: each new name starts at the nadir of stake-age, and buying real influence means locking more capital for longer, with no bonus for multiplying names.
